name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
description: Focused development of fisheries sector with financial subsidies for aquaculture, boats, ponds, and cold chains.
benefits: 40% to 60% capital subsidy on fisheries infrastructure and equipment
documents_required: Land / Water Body Lease or Ownership Proof

criteria.description: Applicant must be actively engaged in fisheries or aquaculture
criteria.disqualification_reason: Applicant does not work in fisheries or aquaculture
